Agent Name: Gaming_Awards_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Gaming_Awards_Expert incorrectly identified the 2019 British Academy Games Awards winner. The game "God of War" won the award in 2019, but it was actually released in 2018. The task required identifying the game that won in 2019, not a game awarded in 2019. This led to the incorrect analysis of the Wikipedia page for "God of War" instead of the intended game, which was "Outer Wilds," the 2019 winner. This initial error led to all subsequent analysis being based on the wrong game.
